messages:
Nina: quick design QA from today's console pass — two small things: modal stack overlap with top toast and the ghost button focus stroke looks thinner at compact scale.
Owen: agree on toast overlap. i've seen toasts land above a modal header when the modal is anchored to top. what's our desired z-index hierarchy? Modals > Toaster or Toaster > Modals?
Tess: modals should take precedence visually but toasts need to be visible when a modal is non-modal (like a banner). propose: toasts default below modals, but toasts with `persistent` flag float above.
Nina: that sounds reasonable. default rule: z-modal = 600, z-toast = 500, z-toast.persistent = 650. keeps most ephemeral toasts behind, persistent ones still break through.
Victor: small nit on ghost button: on compact rows the focus ring is 1px and gets lost against patterned table rows. can we bump to 2px for ghost variant in compact? maybe token `focus-ring-compact: 2px solid var(--focus)`.
Owen: yes — but ensure we don't exceed our visual weight for normal focus states. only apply on ghost/outline variants in dense modes.
Tess: also saw a wrinkle with modal close spacing: close icon is 12px from edge on desktop but 8px on compact; with thicker focus it collides. let's keep edge padding >= 12px when focus visible.
ui-bot: quick accessibility scan queued.
ui-bot: result: Increased focus thickness to 2px maintains contrast. z-index hierarchy recommended: modal (600) > persistent-toast (650) > toast (500) would be inconsistent — consider persistent-toast at 700. Recommendation: modals (700), persistent-toast (650), toasts (500). :information_source:
Nina: good catch on ordering — i prefer modals highest (700), persistent toasts below that at 650. update action: set modal z = 700, regular toast z = 500, persistent toast z = 650; add compact focus token `focus-ring-compact: 2px` applied to ghost buttons and inline controls. also increase modal close hit padding to 12px when focus present.
Victor: one more: table density. when we make ghost focus thicker, visually rows feel tighter. suggest adding vertical token `row-gap-dense +2px` only when ghost focus enabled.
Owen: ok for that as a compensating tweak. action: nina to update figma and post link. i'll make a small PR for z-index tokens in codebase.
Tess: sounds good. please add a short note in the component doc about persistent-toasts semantics.
Nina: will do and will attach updated components figma link here once pushed. thanks all :raised_hands:
